t: The $(thing)Fluid Filter/$ is a widget solely used as $(thing)parameter/$ for other widgets. You can use it to specify a certain fluid by $(thing)right-clicking/$ the widget and searching/selecting fluids in the resulting search GUI.
$(thing)流体过滤器/$是一种仅作为其他控件的$(thing)参数/$使用的控件。你可以通过$(thing)右击/$该控件，在随后出现的搜索界面中搜索并选择流体，以此指定某种特定的流体。
